query:
-- Get the organization ID for sensei@mydojomartialarts.com
SELECT ou.organizationId 
FROM organization_users ou 
JOIN users u ON ou.userId = u.id 
WHERE u.email = 'sensei@mydojomartialarts.com' 
LIMIT 1;

-- Update the AI credit balance (add 50,000 credits)
UPDATE ai_credit_balance 
SET balance = balance + 50000, 
    totalPurchased = totalPurchased + 50000,
    updatedAt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE organizationId = (
  SELECT ou.organizationId 
  FROM organization_users ou 
  JOIN users u ON ou.userId = u.id 
  WHERE u.email = 'sensei@mydojomartialarts.com' 
  LIMIT 1
);

-- Verify the update
SELECT acb.balance, acb.totalPurchased 
FROM ai_credit_balance acb
WHERE acb.organizationId = (
  SELECT ou.organizationId 
  FROM organization_users ou 
  JOIN users u ON ou.userId = u.id 
  WHERE u.email = 'sensei@mydojomartialarts.com' 
  LIMIT 1
);
